summary.text: Lori Berman is a Democratic member of the Florida Senate for District 26, elected on April 10, 2018.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate's biographical page, Berman served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018.

Berman is an attorney with a B.A. from Tufts University (1980), a J.D. from George Washington University Law School (1983) and an LL.M. in estate planning from the University of Miami (2002), and was born in New York City.
